name: Catch Cans & Breathers
description: Crankcase and dry-sump tank ventilation: valve-cover breathers, tank vent, air/oil separator with drain-back, breather filter and optional crankcase vacuum.

components.name: Factory PCV system (reference) & fresh-air port
components.description: The LT4 meters crankcase gases into the supercharger inlet under vacuum and uses a fresh-air line from the intake tube under boost. With a dry sump the crankcase is mostly evacuated by the scavenge stages and vented through the oil tank; the factory PCV is commonly retained only as a fresh-air/vent path through a catch can, or blocked off per engine builder.
components.location: Valve covers / front of supercharger / intake tube.

factory.name: GM LT4 PCV hoses and integrated PCV orifice

raceOptions.name: Catch can on the PCV (dirty) side with check valve

installNotes: Coordinate with engine builder—blocking PCV on a boosted engine without adequate vent capacity pressurizes the crankcase.

components.name: Fresh-air / breather port on intake tube
components.description: Port on the intake tube (filtered side) for the crankcase fresh-air line or the catch-can return, so crankcase vapors are not vented to atmosphere where rules prohibit it.
components.location: Intake tube between MAF and throttle body.

hardware.spec: -10 AN 37° flare (JIC-compatible), aluminum or stainless hose end
hardware.threadlocker: none — light oil on threads and 37° seat (no sealant on flares)
hardware.reuse: Inspect (replace if seat galled or cracked)
hardware.notes: Assemble flare joints at the low end of the range; aluminum fittings gall easily. If it weeps, tighten in small increments without exceeding max. Mark with torque stripe.

installNotes: Place after the MAF (for MAF-based tunes, metered air must not bypass).

components.name: Valve cover breather fittings
components.description: AN breather fittings (with internal baffles) in each valve cover so crankcase pressure from blow-by is vented to the catch can rather than past the seals.
components.location: Top of each valve cover, rear.

hardware.spec: -10 AN 37° flare (JIC-compatible), aluminum or stainless hose end
hardware.threadlocker: none — light oil on threads and 37° seat (no sealant on flares)
hardware.reuse: Inspect (replace if seat galled or cracked)
hardware.notes: Assemble flare joints at the low end of the range; aluminum fittings gall easily. If it weeps, tighten in small increments without exceeding max. Mark with torque stripe.

installNotes: Ensure the valve cover port is baffled so oil splash is not pulled out.

components.location: Oil tank top (right front) rearward along the passenger side to the catch can at the firewall.

components.name: Catch can / air-oil separator (with drain-back)
components.description: Baffled can that separates oil mist from crankcase/tank vapors. Most sanctioning bodies require a catch can (often >= 1 qt / 1 L) on any breather that would otherwise vent to atmosphere. Can drains back to the dry-sump tank.
components.location: Passenger side of the engine bay at the firewall, above the oil tank level.

raceOptions.name: Moroso / Canton / Peterson air-oil separator (1-2 qt)
Elite Engineering E2X / RX catch can for ZL1 PCV

hardware.spec: -10 ORB (SAE J1926 straight-thread O-ring boss) port fitting with Viton/FKM O-ring
hardware.threadlocker: none — lubricate O-ring with clean oil/fuel; no thread sealant
hardware.notes: ORB seals on the O-ring, not the threads. Values are typical aluminum-port guidance; follow fitting maker (Earl's/XRP/Fragola) if listed.

installNotes: Mount above the tank oil level so it drains by gravity.
inspection: Empty/inspect after every session if no drain-back

components.name: Catch can drain-back line (-6 AN) with check valve
components.description: Returns separated oil from the can bottom to the dry-sump tank (or pan scavenge) with a one-way check valve so tank pressure cannot push oil up into the can.
components.location: Can bottom forward to the oil tank.

components.name: Catch-can breather filter / vent
components.description: Small filter on the catch can vent (atmospheric) or a return line to the intake tube fresh-air port, depending on rules and the engine builder.

images.title: Forum: Elite E2-X catch can 9.6 in tall x 3.1 in dia with fittings

components.name: Crankcase vacuum (optional pump stage / regulator)
components.description: Option: size scavenge stages (or add a dedicated vacuum stage) to pull 5-15 inHg of crankcase vacuum for ring seal and power, with an adjustable vacuum regulator/relief on the tank or valve cover. Requires sealed breathers (check valves) and a builder-specified setup.

raceOptions.name: Dailey roots-pump vacuum capability / Peterson vacuum regulator

installNotes: Fit a crankcase vacuum gauge/sensor and a relief valve.
